listing.title: Citrus Mug, Watercolor Orange and Lemon All Over Print Coffee Mug, Blood Orange Mug, Citrus Fruit Pattern Mug, Kitchen Gift for Her
listing.description: Watercolor oranges, clementines, blood oranges, lemons, limes and grapefruit, some whole with glossy green leaves and some cut into juicy wheels and half-moons, fill the whole mug with sprigs of white orange blossom, cinnamon sticks, star anise and pale blue snowflakes on a warm cream background. There's no slogan or name, so it suits any citrus lover: for a winter birthday, a bright January morning or a sunny kitchen all year.

listing.trademark_check: Legal Desk screen 2026-11-24: web searches '"winter citrus" trademark' and '"Winter Citrus" brand mug OR candle OR apparel trademark registered' found no WINTER CITRUS mark. Nearby records: WINTER CITRUS WREATH (Bath & Body Works Brand Management, serial 90538513, filed 2021-02-22 for hand soap, Class 3; its status wasn't visible), WINTER SWEETZ (registered, fresh fruit), Winter Garden Citrus Products Cooperative's older citrus marks, and Frieda's 'winter citrus' produce program (marketing wording, no mark seen). None covers mugs. The art has no lettering; the title and tags use only plain descriptions ('citrus', 'orange', 'lemon', 'blood orange', 'grapefruit', 'lime', 'orange blossom') and never 'Winter Citrus Wreath'. 'Winter Citrus' is the studio's internal design name only. No brand stickers, labels or crate art are drawn. tmsearch.uspto.gov is blocked from our sessions; this is a search-engine screen, not a clearance.
